honest_c3: N=1 ckpt (BG-JD step 800 only) — multi-ckpt decoding sweep deferred. BG-IL/IO ckpts on ubu1 only (git size policy); cross-ckpt verification requires rsync from ubu1 OR ubu1 BG extension.

Forced-include decoding (M4) may produce incoherent output — forced tokens stand out as non-sequitur if model native distribution doesn't favor the fact word at that position. V5.8 pass via M4 = technical fact-presence + function-word + non-regurgitation, but coherence heuristic (english_word_count≥3 AND english_function_word_count≥1) reported separately for honest interpretation.
block_size=256 truncation possible for long T2 contexts (T1+T1A+T2 may exceed); recorded in raw_records per turn (truncated flag, n_new_tokens_actual).

Decoding sweep tests inference-time intervention only — does NOT test training-time fixes (LM head fine-tune / RLHF / chat-template SFT deferred to BG-JR / BG-JS). If all 4 strategies FAIL, conclusion = architectural output bottleneck deep, training-time intervention required.

Internal awareness STRONG (BG-JO V6: Method B 0.998, Method C 1.00) is necessary not sufficient for production output — this BG verifies if production-side fix exists at decoding layer assuming awareness is intact.

Persona-cycle token enumeration (M3) uses substring match against SP piece strings with fixed substring list ['법칙', '우주뇌지도', '도우미', '사용자', '[anima']; may miss morphological variants OR over-match common substrings. List based on BG-JN observed cycle outputs; logic-exhaustive enumeration deferred.
M4 force_token_ids resolution uses sp.encode + piece substring match; SP byte fallback or rare token IDs may not be discovered. n_force_ids per dialogue logged in raw_records for verification.
Sample mode uses fixed seed 42 for reproducibility, but per-temp/per-p variance in 1-shot per dialogue × 1 sample = high variance; multi-seed (≥5) sweep deferred.
V5.8 fact-recall PASS criteria reused as-is from BG-JN/ amend EN v2 (case-insensitive substring + function word ≥1 + lev_ratio<0.85). Threshold calibration for forced-include scenarios deferred.
